major_findings: TP03 completes the Tianfu-Taiyin-Tanlang-Jumen-Tianxiang transition and begins Tianliang within Property Palace, preserving property, residence, service-institution, dispute, relocation, fengshui and event-candidate semantics as separate projection domains.
Nine archived condition/target/scope surfaces required source-preserving correction or narrowing.
TP03-205 directly confirms the separate 空劫夹亦主破败 branch and closes TP02-GAP-001 without folding it into the preceding relocation/sale branch.
TP03-208 remains antecedent-dependent on the preceding Tianfu flanking context; no universal pressure-category operator is created.
TP03-252/266/278/287 preserve nonstandard or damaged source wording instead of silently normalizing it.
TP03-273 preserves explicit 大运+流年 source scope while retaining legacy DECADE compatibility.

TP03-291 narrows the damaged `主倾效` clause to a bounded adverse property direction; TP03-290 is restored to the source-explicit 武曲化禄 -> 产业丰厚 reading; TP03-292 removes the unsupported `life/career events` causal gloss.
TP03-261/262 preserve 中年后 as literal life-stage language without numericization.
Independent source critic caught and repaired an internal row-mapping error in the first staged pass: the 武曲化忌 uncertainty belongs to TP03-291, not TP03-290.
